name: rgipt-noc-portal
description: RGIPT NOC Portal - run backend + frontend together

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.demo: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.demo:reset: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "npm run demo:reset --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
